([[Stone Mountain, Georgia]]) | college = *[[Atlanta Metropolitan College|Atlanta Metropolitan]] (2002–2004) *[[Arkansas Razorbacks men's basketball|Arkansas]] (2004–2006) | draft_year = 2006 | career_start = 2006 | career_end = 2018 | career_number = 2 | career_position = [[Shooting guard]] | years1 = 2006–2008 | team1 = [[Dakota Wizards]] | years2 = 2008 | team2 = [[Barons LMT]] | years3 = 2008–2009 | team3 = [[Utah Flash]] | years4 = {{nbay|2008|end}} | team4 = [[Charlotte Bobcats]] | years5 = 2009–2010 | team5 = [[Utah Flash]] | years6 = 2010–2011 | team6 = [[Idaho Stampede]] | years7 = 2011 | team7 = [[Quebec Kebs]] | years8 = 2011 | team8 = [[Idaho Stampede]] | years9 = 2011–2012 | team9 = [[Sioux Falls Skyforce]] | years10 = 2012–2013 | team10 = [[Reno Bighorns]] | years11 = 2013 | team11 = [[Austin Toros]] | years12 = 2014–2015 | team12 = [[Al-Hilal (basketball)|Al-Hilal]] | highlights = * [[All-NBA Development League Team|All-NBA D-League Third Team]] ([[2008–09 NBA Development League season|2009]]) }} '''Dontell Jefferson''' (born December 15, 1983) is an American professional [[basketball]] player. He played briefly in the [[National Basketball Association]] (NBA), as well as stints in the [[NBA Development League]] and in [[Canada]], [[Latvia]], and [[Saudi Arabia]]. He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Arkansas Razorbacks men's basketball|Arkansas Razorbacks]] and [[Atlanta Metropolitan College]]. ==College career== After two years of junior college basketball at [[Atlanta Metropolitan College]], Jefferson completed his college career at the [[University of Arkansas]], lettering in the 2004–05 and 2005–06 seasons. He led the team in assists in 2006 and played in the 2006 NCAA Men's Tournament.{{Cite web |url=http://www.arkansasrazorbacks.com/ViewArticle.dbml?DB_OEM_ID=6100&ATCLID=188062 |title=#4 Dontell Jefferson |access-date=March 2, 2013 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130630105715/http://www.arkansasrazorbacks.com/ViewArticle.dbml?DB_OEM_ID=6100 |archive-date=June 30, 2013 |url-status=dead }} ==Professional career== After his senior season, Jefferson was not selected in the [[2006 NBA draft]]. On March 11, 2009, Jefferson was signed to a 10-day contract by the [[Charlotte Bobcats]].{{cite web |url=http://www.insidehoops.com/blog/?p=3790 |title=Charlotte Bobcats sign Dontell Jefferson to 10-day contract |work=InsideHoops.com |date=March 11, 2009 |accessdate=March 1, 2013}} He signed a second 10-day contract on March 21. He then signed for the remainder of the [[2008–09 NBA season]]. On October 22, 2009, Jefferson was waived by the Bobcats. In 2012, Jefferson was drafted by the [[Reno Bighorns]] in the NBA D-League Draft.[http://www.nba.com/dleague/draft2012/index.html 2012 NBA D-League Draft] {{webarchive |url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121105044827/http://www.nba.com/dleague/draft2012/index.html |date=November 5, 2012 }} On February 22, 2013, he was traded to the [[Austin Toros]].{{Cite web |url=http://www.nba.com/dleague/austin/austin_toros_finalize_trade_with_bighorns_2013_02_22.html |title=Austin Toros Finalize Trade with Reno Bighorns |website=[[NBA.com]] |access-date=March 2, 2013 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140203054945/http://www.nba.com/dleague/austin/austin_toros_finalize_trade_with_bighorns_2013_02_22.html |archive-date=February 3, 2014 |url-status=dead }} In July 2013, [[KTP-Basket]] announced that Jefferson would be part of their 2013–14 roster.[http://www.ktpbasket.fi/sitenews/view/-/nid/399/ngid/1 KTP-Basket sign Jefferson for 2013–14 season.] {{webarchive |url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130726020509/http://www.ktpbasket.fi/sitenews/view/-/nid/399/ngid/1 |date=July 26, 2013 }} However, he left them before the start of the season. In April 2014, he signed with Al Hilal of Libya.[http://www.court-side.com/news/blog/dontell-jefferson-chooses-al-hilal/ Dontell Jefferson chooses Al Hilal] In July 2014 Jefferson signed with Al Ahly in Qatar for the 2014–2015 season. In January 2016 Jefferson signed with Qatar Club in Qatar. In August 2016, Jefferson signed with Al Fateh in Saudi Arabia for the 2016–2017 season. Swingman of the year and First team All Saudi Arabian team.
